quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, reviewed by Daejoo Accounting Corp.): revenue KRW 242,901M vs KRW 179,075M in H1 2025 (+35.6%); gross profit KRW 97,433M (40.1% GM); operating profit KRW 68,886M (28.4% margin) vs KRW 40,307M (+70.9%); net income KRW 68,206M vs KRW 17,255M; basic EPS KRW 5,536 vs 1,397. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 127,799M (+35.6% YoY vs KRW 94,250M; +12.4% QoQ vs KRW 115,102M in Q1), OP KRW 39,088M (30.6% margin, +51.4% YoY vs KRW 25,825M), NI KRW 36,993M (vs KRW 2,794M). FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 380,891M / OP KRW 80,753M / NI KRW 57,565M. MIX: laser markers and laser-applied equipment (own products) KRW 196,308M = 80.8% of revenue, merchandise and other KRW 46,593M = 19.2%. GEOGRAPHY: domestic KRW 109,902M (45.2%) vs KRW 80,471M a year earlier; export KRW 132,999M (54.8%) vs KRW 98,604M; filing says exports are ~55% / domestic ~45% and the ratio moves with customers' capex. Operating cash flow KRW 31,866M (after KRW 29,551M of income tax paid); cash KRW 233,128M plus KRW 104,739M of short-term financial instruments against KRW 7,000M of borrowings (KDB facility loan, 2.02% fixed); debt-to-equity 11.1%, current ratio 712%. H1 FX gains of KRW 14,325M on USD assets (USD 107.0M of foreign-currency assets at 2026-06-30). R&D spend KRW 10,131M = 4.5% of separate revenue (FY2025 6.5%, FY2024 7.7%). Separate-basis revenue KRW 223,987M / OP KRW 62,261M. Consolidated subsidiaries unchanged at 10 (Suzhou manufacturing, Innovavent GmbH optics in Goettingen, sales/service units in Taiwan, Tianjin, Shanghai, Vietnam, India, Singapore, Arizona, and EOL in Gwangju). Employees 651 at 2026-06-30.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 rev KRW 242.9B (+35.6% YoY); OP KRW 68.9B (28.4%); Q2 rev KRW 127.8B (+35.6% YoY, +12.4% QoQ), Q2 OP KRW 39.1B (30.6%); export 54.8%; products 80.8% of mix

quarterly_data.signal: Customers and concentration (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): DISCLOSED SALES COUNTERPARTIES overseas: ASE, SPIL, Texas Instruments, Micron and others (T/T, L/C terms); domestic: Samsung Electronics, Amkor Technology, SK Hynix, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, LG Display and others (cash / electronic settlement). Sales are made directly to the end user: quote -> spec meeting -> delivery -> installation -> acceptance. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION (anonymised, >=10% of consolidated H1 revenue): Customer A KRW 43,329M (17.8%), Customer B KRW 30,352M (12.5%) — a year earlier Customer A was KRW 51,176M (28.6%) and no second customer exceeded 10%, so the top customer's share has halved while a second large account emerged. Market share for semiconductor laser markers: ~95% in Korea, ~60% overseas (company estimate from installed base; no official statistics). The filing discloses NO order backlog figure (build-to-order equipment). Advances received from customers KRW 9,124M at 2026-06-30 vs KRW 12,920M at 2025-12-31; trade receivables (gross) KRW 123,412M vs KRW 104,461M, allowance 13.7%. Continuous new-product development for semiconductor, display, PCB and handset customers is done under customer NDAs. No supply-contract disclosures (section XI) in the period.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 17.8% (KRW 43.3B), Customer B 12.5% (KRW 30.4B) of H1 rev; customers ASE, SPIL, TI, Micron, Samsung, Amkor, SK Hynix, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, LG Display; ~95% Korea / ~60% overseas laser-marker share; no backlog disclosed

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity, capex and supply (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): equipment is high-value build-to-order so the company does not publish capacity or utilisation figures. H1 production output (= sales) KRW 242,901M (products KRW 196,308M, merchandise KRW 46,593M) vs KRW 380,891M for all of FY2025. PP&E ADDITIONS KRW 13,958M in H1 2026 vs KRW 1,907M in H1 2025 — land KRW 8,965M, buildings KRW 1,117M, construction-in-progress KRW 2,531M (CIP balance KRW 3,021M at 2026-06-30 vs KRW 504M at year-end), machinery KRW 452M plus KRW 1,045M of inventory reclassified to machinery; the board approved a real-estate purchase on 2026-06-29. The filing states no investment in progress and no future investment plan. RAW MATERIALS: purchase mix domestic 69.6% (machinery and parts) / imported 30.4% (lasers, control units); supplier names withheld as trade secrets; H1 raw-material purchases KRW 90,163M (+29.3% YoY vs KRW 69,721M) and merchandise purchases KRW 20,405M. Inventory KRW 117,839M at 2026-06-30 (work-in-process KRW 44,627M, raw materials KRW 35,962M, finished goods KRW 28,198M, goods in transit KRW 2,597M vs KRW 219M at year-end); inventory turnover 2.5x (2.1x in FY2025); inventory write-down KRW 2,646M in H1 vs KRW 9,288M a year earlier. The Suzhou subsidiary's contract-processing business was discontinued in October 2024; Suzhou (H1 revenue KRW 12,227M) remains the overseas equipment-manufacturing base.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 PP&E additions KRW 14.0B (vs 1.9B), land KRW 9.0B; CIP KRW 3.0B; raw-material buys KRW 90.2B (+29%); imports 30.4% (lasers, controllers); inventory KRW 117.8B, WIP KRW 44.6B; no capacity figure (build-to-order)

quarterly_data.signal: Catalysts and corporate events (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): CREDIT RATINGS UPGRADED in 2026 — Korea Data Rating to AA from AA- (citing very strong credit capacity), NICE D&B to AA- from A+ (revenue growth and higher operating margin), eCredible A+ maintained. DIVIDEND POLICY: target 25% of consolidated net income, with an intention to raise dividends for shareholder value (may be reduced if large investments arise); FY2025 DPS KRW 1,200 (KRW 14,783M paid 2026-04, 25.8% payout) vs KRW 500 for FY2024; the charter now allows board-resolved interim dividends. CHARTER: the 2026-03-31 AGM added 10 business purposes on 2026-04-10 (management consulting, M&A brokerage, technology licensing, software, IP licensing, media/music production, restaurants, space rental) for diversification — planned investment KRW 10,000M from internal funds, 7 staff, no revenue yet, no link to the core business; independent-director rules take effect 2026-07-23. R&D: 25 commercialised projects listed (wafer-level CSP markers, 300mm wafer-level CSP marking, multi-beam laser markers, wafer dicing, laser stencil cutting, glass cutter/marker, laser welder, built-in vision); H1 R&D KRW 10,131M. INVESTMENTS: on 2026-05-15 bought 8,800 Samsung shares (KRW 2,494M) and 1,300 SK Hynix shares (KRW 2,562M) as FVOCI holdings; also holds Dongwoon Anatech, Hanwool Semiconductor and Vieworks stakes. LITIGATION: a Chinese insurer's subrogation suit over equipment damaged in sea transit — Shenzhen court first-instance ruling against the company on 2025-12-26, provision KRW 1,881M including interest, appeal in progress. Auditor changed to Daejoo Accounting Corp. for FY2026. Share price KRW 476,000 at 2026-06-30 (vs KRW 272,000 at 2025-12-31); H1 monthly average price rose from KRW 314,857 in January to KRW 482,786 in June. Largest shareholder Sung Kyu-dong and related parties 31.06%; Baillie Gifford among 14 holders above 1% (together 34.45%).
quarterly_data.figure: Ratings up: Korea Data Rating AA, NICE D&B AA-; dividend policy 25% of NI, FY2025 DPS KRW 1,200; 10 new charter purposes 04-10-2026 (KRW 10B plan); bought Samsung/SK Hynix shares 05-15-2026; Shenzhen suit provision KRW 1.9B under appeal
